propositions: A literal latest completed INDETERMINATE review with successful and retryable units can be retried with --retry to call only missing units and reuse prior content-identical results without re-running successful checkpoints.

Eligible retry units are classified as reusable (success/resumed kind from discovery_journal) or missing (failed/cancelled kind plus budget_indeterminate findings), with checkpoint digest recomputation to validate material/policy/prompt/contract/model/mode/topology/context/dependency/source identity.

The retry path loads prior CheckpointEnvelope findings via sizing.load_checkpoint for reusable units, issues model calls only for missing units, and reruns deterministic decision/assembly/verification/coaching over the combined result set.

Each explicit --retry invocation grants a fresh per-invocation attempt budget; cumulative lineage spend is audited but never enforced as a cap; stale/corrupt/legacy/digest-mismatched journals refuse before any model call and exit with code 2.
The --retry flag is mutually exclusive with --force, --status, and --check but compatible with --no-sign; retry is a CLI/library operator affordance excluded from MCP tool surface.

Documentation must cover eligibility criteria, fresh budget semantics, reused blocker/success behavior, zero-call refusal, flag interactions, signing behavior, and the normal full-review remedy across help, CLI reference, user guide, plan-review gate guide, and exit-codes guide.
